climate: Most rain falls in winter. Dry summers keep mildew and rot down, though young vines may need watering.

blurb.text: One of the oldest, smallest and northernmost active AVAs in California, a narrow 6,000-acre valley cut by the Trinity River in the Klamath Mountains. It is rugged, with lots of sunlight and heat. By 2008 it had no bonded wineries and only ten acres of vines.
